answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 7208 Country: India Title: I love a girl, she was hindu at present. i can marry her after converting into islam. please answer as early as possible. Question: assalamwalaikum. I love a girl, she was hindu at present. i can marry her after converting into islam. please answer as early as possible. Answer ID: 7208 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1613/1378=B/1429) First of all, consult your parents and senior family members and then only move ahead. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
